Matches saving an empty enabled usage limit and receiving Voucher updated while the invalid change remains unsaved.
Matches the contradictory limited-countries heading and applies-to-all-countries empty state on a saved shipping voucher.
Matches the Name sort indicator producing an order inconsistent with displayed voucher names, including after switching to descending.
Matches the voucher channel chooser incorrectly titled Manage Products Channel Availability.
Matches the Percentage discount-type filter including vouchers whose offer is Free shipping.
Matches the Active status clipping to Ac at 390px. The hidden voucher name is an additional bundled observation.
Matches confirming eligible category assignments in a new Products voucher and replacing the editor with an unexpected-error page.
Matches setup guidance claiming one shared percentage while the editor supports different percentages per channel.
Matches the terminal skeleton instead of a missing-voucher state, but reaches it through a malformed ID rather than a deleted voucher URL.
Matches the country dialog's select-all checkbox incorrectly referring to channels, including its filtered wording.
Matches narrow-layout eligibility descriptions overlapping assignment counts; this finding additionally demonstrates the overlap at phone width.
Matches accepting a blank manual code and displaying an empty Draft row. The finding does not demonstrate backend persistence.
Matches invalid-percentage creation leaving an incomplete voucher with a code but no channel discounts. The predicted second creation is not demonstrated.
Matches the overflowing mobile search field and sideways content shift. Calling the shifted container the whole document does not change the observed failure.
The reported second attempt matches the blank date and lingering Schedule dirty state after successful Save. Blank-date defaulting itself is intended.
Matches Set value failing to scroll to the discount field at mobile width. Add codes is an additional bundled shortcut failure.
